remarks: Submit H&B offers by 6pm SUNDAY 1/25. Set on 1.25 private, tree-lined acres, this fully renovated ranch offers refined one-level living w/exceptional indoor-outdoor flow. Thoughtfully updated inside and out over the past 15 years, this home is truly turnkey-blending craftsmanship, comfort, and function. Warm hardwood floors run throughout the light-filled open floor plan, while the wall of sliders invites the outdoors in, creating an ideal setting for both everyday living & effortless entertaining. The fully rebuilt kitchen features quartz countertops, counter seating, wine refrigerator, S/S appliances, generous cabinetry, & double ovens incl a conv/micro combo. The living room is anchored by a new gas fireplace w/ beautifully retiled hearth & mantle. The serene primary suite has been fully reimagined w/ a spa-like bath offering a zero-entry shower, 6' soaking tub, double sinks, & a private slider to the backyard. A bedroom/office sits nearby, w/ two add'l bedrooms & an updated hall bath privately positioned on the opposite wing. Outdoor living shines w/ expansive patios, retractable awnings, fire pit, greenhouse & shed. LL workshop provides add'l options as private office/man cave/she shed. Add'l highlights: insulated 2-car garage, propane conv w/ high-efficiency HVAC, central a/c, tankless HW, newer roof, skylights, windows, & generator prep. Don't miss this rare opportunity for turnkey, single-level living in a welcoming neighborhood w/ community events. See feature sheet.
